children: AITX reported selected operating cash payments fell ~14% in August as cost-reduction plan execution begins.
Selected cash payments declined roughly $141,500 (≈14%) in August vs. July, totaling ~$900,400 in August.
Decline driven by lower payroll, consulting/professional fees and sales & marketing expenses.
Company remains on track for ~ $200,000 monthly cash SG&A reductions by Dec 31, 2026 if plan sustains.
Figures are preliminary, unaudited and subject to adjustment; month-to-month timing items may affect comparatives.
Improved cost control intended to lower revenue needed to achieve positive monthly cash flow from operations.
